system.description:
During a Surprise Round, before combat begins, if you are not Surprised you can give up your Standard Action to allow all non-Surprised allies within your line of sight to take an extra Move Action during the Surprise Round.

Allies can spend this Move Action to instead reroll their Initiative checks and take the better of the two results as a Free Action before combat begins.

holocron.sourceBook: Star Wars Saga Edition Scum and Villainy
